label: Places and Buildings
heading: Egyptian Arabic Places and Buildings — 59 Words

examples.arabic: أيام العيد كانت قربت أوي وماتش مصر كمان.
examples.english: Eid days were very close, and Egypt's match was also coming soon.
examples.transliteration: Ayam el Eid kanet 2arabet awi w match Masr kaman.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: يا رب الكاس يفضل في مصر السنة دي.
examples.english: Oh Lord, may the cup stay in Egypt this year.
examples.transliteration: Ya rab el kas yefdal fi masr el sana di.

examples.arabic: النهاردة أول يوم في العيد الكبير في مصر.
examples.english: Today is the first day of the big holiday in Egypt.
examples.transliteration: En-naharda awwil yom fi el-eid el-kebir fi masr.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: إحنا بنصلي للعائلات في إيران و كل مكان.
examples.english: We pray for the families in Iran and every place.
examples.transliteration: Ehna binsalli lil-ailat fi Iran wa kull makan.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: النهارده لعبنا كورة والمكان كان رائع
examples.english: Today we played football and the place was wonderful
examples.transliteration: el naharda leebna kora wel makan kan raea

examples.arabic: المكان كان رائع وفيه حاجات كتير
examples.english: The place was wonderful and had many things.
examples.transliteration: El makan kan raeaa wa feeh hagat keteer

examples.arabic: مهم نختار رئيس الجمهورية اللي يقود البلد كويس
examples.english: It's important to choose the President of the Republic who will lead the country well.
examples.transliteration: Mohimm nekhtār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya elli yaʾūd el-balad kwayyis.

examples.arabic: بس زمان كان فيه احساس تاني بالحكم وان البلد دي بتاعتنا كلنا مش مجرد احزاب وخلاص
examples.english: But back then there was a different feeling about governance, and that this country was all ours, not just parties and that's it.
examples.transliteration: Bas zamān kān fīh eḥsās tānī bel-ḥokm w en el-balad dī betaʿetna kollena mesh mogarrad aḥzāb w khalas.

examples.arabic: هما عايشين في بيت بسيط في القاهرة.
examples.english: They live in a simple house in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Homa 3ayeshin fi beit baset fi El Qahera.

examples.arabic: ركبوا العربية بتاعتهم وراحوا السوق الكبير في القاهرة.
examples.english: They got into their car and went to the big market in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Rakbou el 3arabeya beta3ethom we rahou el soo2 el kebir fi el Qahera.

examples.arabic: أحمد راح السوق الكبير في القاهرة امبارح.
examples.english: Ahmed went to the big market in Cairo yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed rah el sooq el kebir fel Qahera embareh.

examples.arabic: أحمد وأصحابه كل يوم بيلعبوا كورة في الشارع جنب بيوتهم.
examples.english: Ahmed and his friends play football every day in the street next to their houses.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed w as7abo kol yom beyel3abu kora fel shari3 gamb beyoot'hom.

examples.arabic: أحمد ونور كانوا بيلعبوا كورة في الشارع.
examples.english: Ahmed and Nour were playing football in the street.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed we Nour kano beyel3abo kora fi el share3.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: العيال الصغيرين نطوا في الشارع والجيران فتحوا شبابيكهم.
examples.english: The small children jumped in the street and the neighbors opened their windows.
examples.transliteration: El eyal el soghayarin nato fel share' wel geran fataho shababikhom.

examples.arabic: قعدنا نتكلم شوية كتير عن اخبار العيلة والبلد
examples.english: We sat and talked a lot about family news and the country
examples.transliteration: Qaʿadnā netkallem shwaya kitīr ʿan akhbār el-ʿēla wel-balad

examples.arabic: مهم نختار رئيس الجمهورية اللي يقود البلد كويس
examples.english: It's important to choose the President of the Republic who will lead the country well.
examples.transliteration: Mohimm nekhtār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya elli yaʾūd el-balad kwayyis.

examples.arabic: بس زمان كان فيه احساس تاني بالحكم وان البلد دي بتاعتنا كلنا مش مجرد احزاب وخلاص
examples.english: But back then there was a different feeling about governance, and that this country was all ours, not just parties and that's it.
examples.transliteration: Bas zamān kān fīh eḥsās tānī bel-ḥokm w en el-balad dī betaʿetna kollena mesh mogarrad aḥzāb w khalas.

examples.arabic: يوسف: كويس جداً. إحنا هنروح النادي النهاردة.
examples.english: Youssef: Very good. We are going to the club today.
examples.transliteration: Youssef: Kwayyes geddan. Ehna hanroo7 el nady ennaharda.

examples.arabic: بعدين، لعبنا كورة في النادي لحد ما الشمس غابت.
examples.english: Then, we played football in the club until the sun set.
examples.transliteration: baaden, leebna kora fe el nady lahad ma el shams ghabet.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: احمد قابل سارة في النادي وقال لها صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك
examples.english: Ahmed met Sarah at the club and told her good morning Sarah how are you.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed qabel Sara fi el nady wa aal laha sabaḥ el kheer ya Sara izzayyik.

examples.arabic: كان فيه ماتش كورة في الملعب
examples.english: There was a football match in the stadium.
examples.transliteration: Kan feeh match kora fil-mal'ab.

examples.arabic: هو انضم لمدرسة كبيرة عشان يتعلم الرسم في المدينة.
examples.english: He joined a big school to learn drawing in the city.
examples.transliteration: Huwa indamm le madrasa kibeera ashan yit-allim el rasm fel madina.

examples.arabic: علي عايز يسافر اسكندرية في الاجازة
examples.english: Ali wants to travel to Alexandria on the weekend.
examples.transliteration: Ali ayez yesafer Eskendereya fi el agaza

examples.arabic: بابا عايز يروح اسكندرية
examples.english: Dad wants to go to Alexandria.
examples.transliteration: Baba ayez yerouh eskendereya.

examples.arabic: انا عايز اروح اسكندرية يوم الجمعة
examples.english: I want to go to Alexandria on Friday
examples.transliteration: Ana ayiz aruh Iskandariyya yom el gomaa

examples.arabic: النهاردة فيه ماتش كورة بين الاهلي والزمالك
examples.english: Today there is a football match between Al Ahly and Al Zamalek.

examples.arabic: منى وصلت كافيه زمالك الساعة سبعة إلا ربع، شافت حاجة غريبة في المنيو.
examples.english: Mona arrived at Zamalek Café at a quarter to seven, she saw something strange on the menu.
examples.transliteration: Mona wasalet kafeh Zamalek el-sa'a sab'a ella rob', shafet haga ghariba fel-menyu.

examples.arabic: أنا قاعد في قهوة في الزمالك مع صاحبي عمر.
examples.english: I am sitting in a coffee shop in Zamalek with my friend Omar.
examples.transliteration: Ana qa'ed fi 'ahwa fi el-Zamalek ma'a sahbi 'Omar.

examples.arabic: أمريكا و إسرائيل في الحرب ضد إيران.
examples.english: America and Israel are in the war against Iran.
examples.transliteration: Amrika wa Israil fi el-harb did Iran.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: أختي بتسأل عن أهداف البلاد دي.
examples.english: My sister asks about the goals of these countries.
examples.transliteration: Okhti bitisal an ahdaf el-bilad di.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: هو شاف أصحابه علي ومنى جنب محل الفاكهة.
examples.english: He saw his friends Ali and Mona next to the fruit shop.
examples.transliteration: Howa shaf ashabo Ali w Mona gamb mahl el faka.

examples.arabic: شفت راجل بيشتغل في محل وقلت له السلام عليكم
examples.english: I saw a man who works in a shop and I said to him peace be upon you.

examples.arabic: احمد راح المحل عشان يشتري هدوم
examples.english: Ahmed went to the shop to buy clothes.
examples.transliteration: ahmed raah el mahal ashan yeshtery hedoom

examples.arabic: أختي بتسأل عن أهداف البلاد دي.

examples.arabic: علي رد عليه: صح، إحنا دايماً بنحب بلدنا وفريقنا.
examples.english: Ali replied to him: Right, we always love our country and our team.
examples.transliteration: Ali rad aleh: Sah, ehna dayman benheb baladna wa fariqna.
